details.description: grok-imagine-image is xAI's original text-to-image model in the Grok Imagine product line, generating images from text prompts via the xAI API (POST /v1/images/generations) at 1K or 2K resolution. It is also reachable under the dated alias grok-imagine-image-2026-03-02. xAI's current docs feature only the newer grok-imagine-image-2.0 for image generation and editing.
advantages: Supports generating up to 10 image variations of the same prompt in a single batch request, via the Grok Imagine image-generation API shared across xAI's image models (xAI image-generation docs).
Configurable aspect ratio and response format (URL or base64), per xAI's image-generation API docs.
disadvantages: The quality parameter (low, medium, auto) available on grok-imagine-image-2.0 is not supported on this model (xAI image-generation docs).
xAI recommends grok-imagine-image-2.0 over this model for image generation (xAI models page).
use_cases: General text-to-image generation via the xAI API
Applications that specifically target the original/base Grok Imagine image model rather than Image 2.0

notes: xAI's client-side model registry (docs.x.ai, __XAI_PUBLIC_MODELS__) lists 'grok-imagine-image' with alias 'grok-imagine-image-2026-03-02' (matching the catalog's second uri), text+image input modalities, and image output, matching the catalog's modality facts. Its resolutionPricing lists both IMAGE_RESOLUTION_1K and IMAGE_RESOLUTION_2K at the same per-image price, and the current pricing page (docs.x.ai/developers/pricing, updated Sept 21, 2026) confirms both a 1K and a 2K row for this model, so it is not 1K-only; the earlier draft misread the registry as a single 1K tier. I could not find a dedicated launch post or model card describing this model on its own, separate from the pricing table and shared API docs; xAI's image-editing guide examples all use grok-imagine-image-2.0, not this model, so I did not claim editing support for this model specifically.
